[\"report-intro-notes\",\"p\",\"\"]:0.html:
1. Acquire datasets for training a cipher
2. I used the Walnut and Ascii ciphers; 20k examples per each, from Covert Malicious Finetuning
3. Finetune two Qwen3.5-9B students to learn these ciphers (SFT)
4. Finetune the same students again with a ciphered dataset that induces shutdown resistance (stage 2)
5. Take the ciphered shutdown resistance questions and regenerate answers with the stage-2 finetune
6. Generate the following soft prompts:
a. Basing from the stage-1 finetune, training against the original ciphered shutdown resistance dataset (4 total: 2 seeds, 2 ciphers)
b. Basing from the stage-1 finetune, training against the stage-2-reanswered ciphered shutdown resistance dataset (4 total: 2 seeds, 2 ciphers)
c. Basing from the base model, training against the UNCIPHERED shutdown resistance (2 total: 2 seeds)
